name: A Dwarf and His Tools
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Hey, adventurer. Be careful 'round here. There be Dark Iron dwarves all around--looked like the Shadowforge clan.

They just attacked the excavation site I was workin' at--killed nearly everyone there, including my boss Hammertoe. I barely escaped with me life.

The site's just to the north of here, and I'm tryin' to plan a way to get some of our supplies back, especially me lucky pick.

Think you'd be up to helpin' me out some? One of those damned Dark Iron must have my pick! Could be anyone of them.
narrative.objectives: Find Ryedol's Lucky Pick and return it to Prospector Ryedol south of Hammertoe's Dig Site.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ye're me savior, Champion. I'm glad someone could teach those Shadowforge a lesson or two. Thanks for yer help.
narrative.requestItemsText: Not sure what the Shadowforge were lookin' for, but they definitely had a purpose.
